name: Wembly
description: Wembly is a well-dressed half-orc who serves as the loyal doorman, bodyguard, and assistant at Havershamble's Jewelry and Fine Mechanicals right next door to Trollskull Manor[cite: 1]. Imposing yet dependable, he stands by the entrance to greet visitors and answer basic questions before bringing guests inside[cite: 1].
ideals: Loyalty: 'I will fight to the death to defend the Havershambles, the shop, and my home[cite: 1].'
bonds: The Havershamble rock gnome family and their fine mechanical shop.
flaws: Completely oblivious to the romantic affections of Beluska, the half-orc proprietress of the nearby boarding house[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Direct, polite, and straightforward when handling visitors at the shop entrance[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Looms by the entrance looking slightly out of place while assisting customers, and stands ready to protect his employers at a moment's notice[cite: 1].
motivations: To guard the Havershamble family and maintain security for their jewelry and mechanical establishment[cite: 1].
knowledge: Familiarity with Havershamble's shop operations, daily visitors, and immediate neighborhood happenings along Trollskull Alley.
gm_notes: Wembly serves as a familiar, friendly face right next door to Trollskull Manor. He can be used to direct players into the jewelry shop, flag down the party for help with problems like a rat infestation in the gnome-sized cellar (which he is too big to enter), or act as a steadfast defender during alley conflicts[cite: 1].
